regions.shortDescription: Small blue uppercase label reading "BUILD TIME" above the slide title.
regions.plainLanguage: A small label at the top says "BUILD TIME".

regions.shortDescription: Step 1 card headed "1 · Draw a random top level" with body text: "Exponential distribution — the hierarchy emerges from a coin flip, no balancing needed." A footnote reads "Probabilities shown for M = 16".
regions.plainLanguage: Step 1 says: pick a random level using an exponential distribution, like a coin flip, so no manual balancing is needed.

regions.shortDescription: Horizontal bar chart showing node probability by level. Level 0: full-width blue bar, 100%. Level ≥ 1: very short blue bar, ~6%. Level ≥ 2: near-invisible bar, ~0.4%.
regions.plainLanguage: A bar chart shows that every node appears at Level 0 (100%), only about 6% reach Level 1 or higher, and about 0.4% reach Level 2 or higher.

regions.shortDescription: Step 2 card headed "2 · Search down, then link to the M nearest" with body text: "A normal search finds the neighborhood; the new node connects to its M closest nodes on each layer it belongs to."
regions.plainLanguage: Step 2 says: search the graph to find the closest existing nodes, then connect the new node to its M nearest neighbors on each layer it joins.

regions.shortDescription: A diagram of a layered graph. An orange node labeled "new vector" sits on a layer plane and is connected by blue edges to three blue neighbor nodes. Grey nodes and grey edges show the rest of the graph. A caption reads "M = 3 new links, on every layer it joins".
regions.plainLanguage: A diagram shows a new orange node being linked to three nearby blue nodes inside a layered graph structure, illustrating that M equals 3 new connections are made on each layer.

regions.shortDescription: Footer text: "If a neighbor exceeds its link budget, its worst edge is pruned — degree stays bounded."
regions.plainLanguage: A note explains that if a neighbor already has too many connections, its weakest link is removed to keep the number of connections under control.
